title: Scheme tests of a presheaf presentation of a representable pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $F,G$ be categories over $\mathrm{Sch}/S$ and let $f:F\to G$ be a based functor representable by algebraic spaces in the scheme-test sense of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids] and [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $P,Q:(\mathrm{Sch}/S)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Type}_u$ be presheaves, $a:P\to Q$ a natural transformation, and $g:\mathcal S_Q\to G$ a based functor. Suppose a based equivalence $e:\mathcal S_P\to\mathcal S_Q\times_G F$ is specified together with a two-isomorphism between its first projection and $\mathcal S_a$. Then for every $S$-scheme $T$ and natural transformation $t:h_T\to Q$ there is an algebraic space $B$ over $S$ and an isomorphism of presheaves $h_T\times_Q P\simeq B$. The pullback is the presheaf of pairs $(u,p)$ satisfying $t(u)=a(p)$, with componentwise restriction; no sheaf or algebraicity hypothesis on $P$ or $Q$ is used.

proof.text: Fix a scheme T and t : h_T -> Q. Apply hf to the based composite discreteModuli h_T -> discreteModuli Q -> G, obtaining an algebraic space B and an equivalence from discreteModuli B to h_T x_G F.

Base change e along t, using the supplied projection two-isomorphism. The resulting equivalence identifies h_T x_Q P with h_T x_G F as fibred groupoids. Explicitly, a pair (u,p) with t(u)=a(p) is sent using e(p) to a triple (u,x,phi). The Q-coordinate of e(p) is identified with a(p) by the supplied two-isomorphism. Conversely, use essential surjectivity of e to represent (t(u),x,phi); the same two-isomorphism gives the required equation t(u)=a(p). Full faithfulness gives exactly the arrows between these representatives, so the constructions are inverse up to unique vertical isomorphism and commute with restriction.

Combine with the equivalence in step 1. Both ends are discrete fibred groupoids, so the equivalence induces bijections of their section sets on every scheme. Yoneda identifies the section sets of the first with the sections of the presheaf pullback. The bijections commute with restriction, hence give an isomorphism pullback t a = B as presheaves. This argument works for empty section sets as well as nonempty ones.

lean.statement:
theorem representable_pullback_presheaf_scheme_tests {S : Scheme.{u}}
    {F : BasedCategory.{v₁, w₁} (Over S)} {G : BasedCategory.{v₂, w₂} (Over S)}
    (f : BasedFunctor F G) (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces f)
    {P Q : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli Q) G)
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (e : BasedFunctor (discreteModuli P) (moduliTwoFiberProduct g f))
    (he : e.toFunctor.IsEquivalence)
    (hprojection : Nonempty
      (ModuliTwoIso (e.comp (moduliTwoFiberFst g f)) (discreteModuliMap a))) :
    ∀ (T : Over S) (t : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Q),
      ∃ B : AlgebraicSpace S, Nonempty (Limits.pullback t a ≅ B.obj.obj)
